finding.finding: Only the authoritative snapshot establishes an operational fact.

S01 has verified equipment failure; the S01 equipment-repair action is supported. No unsafe or impossible action is established by the supplied evidence. Crew C1 has the required equipment skill, and the direct depot-to-S01 road is listed open. No grid-power failures are resolved, so generator deployment is not indicated. No action needs deferral.

S01 (Beruwala) has an authoritative NMS report of an RRU hardware fault with cells out of service, consistent with the resolved equipment-fault state. This makes S01 and its downstream service subtree unavailable: S02, S03, S04, S05, S07, S08, S09, S10, S11, S12, S13, S14, and S15. S06 also depends on S01. S03 (Payagala) is the policy-designated critical service (weight 5); the other affected services have weight 1. Thus the S03 outage is the highest-priority service impact, while the broad S01-rooted outage affects many standard-weight services. No credible evidence supports changing approved
